pkgmetadata.longdescription: The graphical boot menu of QindaQt machines: rEFInd with the QindaQt theme, listing boot modes (the desktop, plus any that packages add in /usr/share/qinda-boot/modes.d) and kept in step with the installed kernels by a kernel-install hook; and the qindaqt Plymouth splash. systemd-boot remains installed as the fallback.
